🚨 3 Kubernetes replicas don't guarantee high availability.

If all 3 pods share one node, a single failure can take them all down.

Use Pod Anti-Affinity, Topology Spread Constraints, and Multi-AZ architecture to improve resilience.

3 Pods ≠ 3 Failure Domains.
